name: Don't Kiss the Shadow Demon
source:
Your entire life is suddenly changed when you are chosen to be the hero of another world.

Unfortunately, in order to prove your conviction to your superiors, you’ve been tasked with a job… to tear out the heart of a demon lurking deep in the underworld

[Edited from [url=https://indecisive-katz.itch.io/dont-kiss-the-shadow-demon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你被选为另一个世界的英雄时，你的整个生活突然改变了。

不幸的是，为了向上级证明你的信念，你被指派了一项工作……挖出潜伏在地下世界深处的恶魔之心。

[编辑自[url=https://indecisive-katz.itch.io/dont-kiss-the-shadow-demon]itch.io[/url]]
